tour.closing: Any old phone. Any factory. TAKUMI notices.
tour.flow_act_1: A maintenance agent drafts the work order and the floor hears it in their language
tour.flow_act_2: A trace-back agent finds the step where a defect started and the units at risk
tour.flow_act_3: Ask TAKUMI by voice: will we make today's orders?
tour.flow_sense_1: Machine Watch reads stack lights, counters and alarm screens
tour.flow_sense_2: Station Watch follows each step of manual work
tour.flow_sense_3: End-of-line inspection photographs every finished unit
tour.flow_subtitle: A camera you already have, mounted and plugged in. The browser watches for free; Gemini looks only when something changes.
tour.flow_understand_1: Gemini finds the machine's lights, counter and screen by itself, no wiring
tour.flow_understand_2: A fast model screens each part; a stronger model confirms defects
tour.flow_understand_3: Every event flows to Pub/Sub and BigQuery, per unit and per machine
tour.footer: Built on Google Cloud: Cloud Run, Firebase, Gemini, Google ADK, Pub/Sub, BigQuery.
tour.headline: Any old phone becomes your factory's quality and operations layer.
tour.moment_machine_text: The light turns red. TAKUMI sees it in seconds, an agent drafts the work order with likely causes, and the alert is spoken in Hindi, Vietnamese or Japanese. A person approves.
tour.moment_station_text: A label goes on the cable instead of the adapter. The station coach notices, says so in the operator's language and points at the fix before the unit moves on.
tour.moment_trace_text: A unit fails at the end of the line. The trace-back agent follows its serial to the step where the defect started, lists the other units at risk and proposes a fix to the work instruction.
tour.moment_trace_title: A bad unit is traced back
tour.moment_voice_text: The supervisor simply asks. Gemini Live answers by voice in any language, using only the factory's own data, and can ask the agents for more.
tour.people_decide: AI informs, people decide: every hold, work order and instruction change is approved by a person.
tour.proof_accuracy: accuracy on {n} real test images (Amazon VisA, CC BY 4.0)
tour.proof_cost_machine: per machine per month for one shift of Machine Watch
tour.proof_cost_part: per inspected part, with {fa}% false alarms
tour.proof_live: {n} Station Watch checks measured in production, median {s} s
tour.proof_stops: machine stops detected on our camera test bench, median {s} s
tour.proof_subtitle: Measured, not promised. Each number carries where it comes from.
tour.scene_caption: Illustration of the test bench. The real one runs in your browser.
tour.scene_label: An old phone watching three machines; one stops and TAKUMI flags it
tour.subhead: TAKUMI watches machines, manual work and finished parts, and Gemini agents turn what it sees into work orders, holds and answers that a person approves.
tour.trust_honest: Every number is labelled LIVE, HOME RIG or PUBLIC DATA.
tour.trust_privacy: No audio is stored. While watching machines, only small crops of the lights, counter and screen leave the phone.
tour.trust_security: No API key in the browser; user text screened by Model Armor.
